detail.longDescription:
Thinking about switching the maths rendering on my website from MathJAX (whose Javascript runs in every client on page view to format LaTeX maths to something pretty) to Pandoc (which runs once on the server on page generation to format LaTeX maths to MathML, allegedly well-supported by browsers now, faster page loads but possibly not as pretty).

I'm curious about opinions: what do you prefer?
